newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 7.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- An Indian group invested $500 million to build an oil refinery in the United Arab Emirates.
- Saudi Arabia's al-Baha Investment Company is to set up three new industrial and agricultural projects in Saudi Arabia worth $20 million.
- Foreign ministers of Qatar and Bahrain are to meet in Riyadh on Tuesday to discuss a territorial dispute.
- Tunisia launched a new drive to woo foreign investments.
- The Arab Monetary Fund signed three financing agreements worth $30 million with Jordan.
